problem: Obsidian does not update image links by default when image files are renamed or moved, causing links to break during vault reorganization.

relations.evidence: Choose Image Link Updater if: you want broken-link prevention to happen automatically in the background — no commands to run, no batch operations.
Choose Image Link Updater if: you want broken-link prevention to happen automatically in the background — no commands to run, no batch operations.

summary: A utility that automatically rewrites broken Markdown image links vault-wide when image files are renamed, moved, or reorganized.
